context: A mom calms her son after a playground fight
purpose: Teach: 倒し/止まり/乱暴/目線/暴れ/なくす/婚約/ズレ

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、公園で年上の子が乱暴で、僕、暴れちゃった。
lines.en: Mom, there was this older kid at the park who was rough with me, and I… I lost it.
lines.style: Choked voice, fighting tears. Speaks in short bursts, shame underneath. Eyes down. The confession of a child who knows he did something wrong but doesn't fully understand why yet.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 落ち着いて。冷静さをなくす前に、お母さん呼んでね。
lines.en: Take a breath. Before you lose control like that, you call for me, okay?
lines.style: Quiet firmness. Not scolding — explaining the rule clearly. Sits down to his eye level. The voice of someone who isn't angry, just teaching.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 走って、その子が転んで倒したの、わざとじゃない。
lines.en: He fell down — I didn't mean to knock him over.
lines.style: Quick, insistent. Still defensive but the urgency has shifted to justification. Small tremor in the voice. Needs her to believe him on this one thing.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 目線を合わせて、ちゃんと謝ろうね。
lines.en: Look him in the eye and say you're sorry. Really say it.
lines.style: Direct but not harsh. Steady voice. Not giving him a way out, but the tone says she'll be there when he does it. Patient clarity.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん。心の中の感情、止まり方が分からなくて。
lines.en: I don't know how to make the feelings stop.
lines.style: Small voice. Quieter now — the fight has gone out of him. Vulnerable admission, the real thing underneath. Slight pause before speaking, like he's searching for words.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: タイミングのズレ、誰にもあるよ。
lines.en: Everyone gets their timing wrong sometimes. That's not just you.
lines.style: Warm, reassuring tone. Not minimizing what happened — normalizing that he's learning. The voice of a mother who isn't here to shame him, but to help him understand.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママの婚約写真、今度見せて。
lines.en: Will you show me your engagement photo sometime?
lines.style: Soft shift — child's curiosity returning now that the hard thing is done. Genuine interest, a little wonder. Testing if they're okay again. Small, hopeful.
